40.name: A Fishy Peril
desc: Remy "Two Times" wants you to speak with Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
objectives: Remy "Two Times" wants you to speak with Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
details: $N, there's a new threat in Elwynn Forest! Murlocs are swimming up the streams of eastern Elwynn, scaring away fish and attacking gentle folk!
BI warned Marshal Dughan, but he's more worried about the gnolls and the bandits. He's not convinced that the murlocs are a danger.
BPlease, $N, speak to Dughan and persuade him to send more troops to the east!
completion: Yes, I spoke with Remy. I respect him as a merchant, though all reports of Murlocs to the east have been sketchy at best.
BYour concerns are noted, but unless I receive a military report of a murloc threat, we can't afford to send more troops east.

64.name: The Forgotten Heirloom
desc: Farmer Furlbrow wants you to retrieve his pocket watch from the wardrobe in his farmhouse at the pumpkin farm to the West.
objectives: Farmer Furlbrow wants you to retrieve his pocket watch from the wardrobe in his farmhouse at the pumpkin farm to the West.
details: It was horrible! Verna woke me when she heard a ruckus in the fields. The fields were full of hooligans. We left in a rush and I forgot to pack my pocket watch. Verna's pa gave me that watch on our wedding day and I feel just sick knowing those thieves have it. I left the pocket watch in the wardrobe at the farmhouse. Look for the field of pumpkins to the West -- you can't miss it. If you bring it back to me, I'd sure be grateful!
completion: My watch! Thank you so much, kind sir!
BWe are but poor farmers and we have lost our land but please accept this reward as a token of our appreciation.

88.name: Princess Must Die!
desc: Kill Princess, grab her collar, then bring it back to Ma Stonefield at the Stonefield Farm.
objectives: Kill Princess, grab her collar, then bring it back to Ma Stonefield at the Stonefield Farm.
details: The Brackwells have a prize-winning pig, Princess. The sow is HUGE, and she got that way from sneaking over here and eating my veggies!
BSo before she comes to our fields...Princess must die! Bring me her collar as proof of the deed and I'll give you something for your time!
BPrincess is usually over at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, to the east and beyond the Maclure farm. Get her before she gets hungry and comes back here!
completion: Thank goodness! That pig was getting so big she'd have eaten our whole crop! Thank you, $N.
BNow, do either of these suit you?

112.name: Collecting Kelp
desc: Bring 4 Crystal Kelp Fronds to William Pestle in Goldshire.
objectives: Bring 4 Crystal Kelp Fronds to William Pestle in Goldshire.
details: I can make an invisibility liquor for Maybell, so she can slip away from the Maclure Vineyards and go to Tommy Joe. But to make the Liquor, I need some crystal kelp.
BAlthough the kelp usually grows in the ocean... sometimes murlocs collect it. See if the murlocs near Crystal Lake have any. Crystal Lake is just east of Goldshire.
completion: You got them. Good show! Now, just one moment while I concoct the potion...

136.name: Captain Sander's Hidden Treasure
desc: Find Captain Sanders' footlocker and search it for the next clue.
objectives: Find Captain Sanders' footlocker and search it for the next clue.
details: If ye be readin' this, it means that Ol' Captain Sanders is in a watery grave. So my treasure is yours now, ye jest need to follow the clues.

BFirst ye need to find me footlocker. It's probably half-buried in sand by now, along the Western Coast of Westfall near the shipwreck. There be lots of shipwrecks but only one rusty anchor on the coast. Find that anchor and you'll find me locker! Look in there for the next clue.
completion: The footlocker slowly creaks open. Sand and water seem to be its only contents. But wait! A small crab scurries out with a clue to the treasure in his claws!

160.name: Note to the Mayor
desc: Bring Abercrombie's Letter to Ello Ebonlocke, Mayor of Darkshire.
objectives: Bring Abercrombie's Letter to Ello Ebonlocke, Mayor of Darkshire.
details: Take this note to Ello Ebonlocke, the Mayor of Darkshire.
BHe and I are old friends...and when he reads it and discovers what you did for me...I'm sure he'll be just as happy as I am! Hahahaha!
completion: <Ello looks at the letter...>
BWhat language is this? It looks ancient...I can't read it.

184.name: Furlbrow's Deed
desc: Bring Furlbrow's Deed to Farmer Furlbrow.
objectives: Bring Furlbrow's Deed to Farmer Furlbrow.
details: This is the deed to an expanse of farmlands within Westfall. It is signed by a Theodore Furlbrow and cosigned by his wife, Verna. And on the back of the deed are hastily scrawled words:
B"We leaned on Furlbrow and got his deed. Thought it might be handy if you wanted to forge one of these for your own place.
BThe Furlbrows won't give us trouble. Last I saw them they were on their way out of Westfall, stuck with a broken wagon."
BYou think the Furlbrows might want their deed back...
completion: Loads of thanks, $N! As I was saying, these parts aren't fit for honest folk anymore, but if things get better, then this deed will let us reclaim our land.
BI don't have much to offer you, but here -- take this.

208.name: Big Game Hunter
desc: Hemet Nesingwary wants you to bring him the head of King Bangalash, the great white tiger.
objectives: Hemet Nesingwary wants you to bring him the head of King Bangalash, the great white tiger.
details: $N, you are a hunter worthy of our company. From the battlefields of Lordaeron to the deepest jungle, I have rarely witnessed such prowess with weaponry as you have demonstrated.

BYou have killed the ferocious Sin'Dall, the elusive Bag'thera and the treacherous Tethis. But the true prize is the head of King Bangalash. That white tiger is the reason I am here. I've had my sights on him for quite some time now. Kill King Bangalash and your hunting prowess is proven to be second to none.
completion: Bloody well done! Right-o! Congratulations, $N, for succeeding where others have failed.
BI am honored to count you as a comrade of our great hunting party here. No one will ever doubt your expertise in hunting and tracking!
BCheers to you, I say! Cheers!

232.name: Errand for Apothecary Zinge
desc: Take the purchase order to Alessandro Luca in the Undercity.
objectives: Take the purchase order to Alessandro Luca in the Undercity.
details: The Royal Apothecary Society needs your assistance. Listen closely, and both of us may profit from my plan.

BApothecary Keever in the next room may be... touched... but his research does potentially bear fruit if it were pursued by a clever researcher. Fortunately, I am such a researcher. I want you to take this purchase order to Alessandro Luca, the proprietor of Blue Moon Odds and Ends; he'll give you a testing kit. When you have it, bring it back to me and I'll outline your task in detail.
completion: Ah, Zinge needs a kit, does she? It saddens me that Zinge does not choose to grace myself with her sweet presence.
BVery well, let me procure a kit for you.

256.name: WANTED: Chok'sul
desc: Kill Chok'sul and bring his head to Magistrate Bluntnose of Thelsamar.
objectives: Kill Chok'sul and bring his head to Magistrate Bluntnose of Thelsamar.
details: By order of the Magistrate of Thelsamar:
BChok'sul, the ogre presumed to be the leader and coordinator of attacks against the town of Thelsamar, Stonewrought Dam, and the excavation site, is wanted dead through any means necessary.
BMonetary compensation will be provided when proof is brought to the Magistrate of Chok'sul's death.
BChok'sul was last seen at the ogre encampment in the northeastern part of Loch Modan.
completion: Yech! What is that thing? And why would you bring it...
BBloody--! Is it? Well, Light burn me, is that the head of that bloody ogre? This certainly is a catch then! Here, your reward and the thanks of myself and the people of Thelsamar.

280.name: A Dark Threat Looms
desc: Chief Engineer Hinderweir wants you to swim down to the base of the dam, locate the powder keg and stir in the Disarming Mixture to prevent an explosion.
objectives: Chief Engineer Hinderweir wants you to swim down to the base of the dam, locate the powder keg and stir in the Disarming Mixture to prevent an explosion.
details: Earlier today I spotted some Dark Iron Insurgents swimming toward the Dam with a large keg. No Mountaineers were on hand to stop them! I'm afraid they've planted the Seaforium at the base of the Dam and it could blow at any minute! Let me combine all these ingredients into the Disarming Mixture. There we go.
BNow I need you to take this mixture and stir it into the keg before it's too late! Hurry!
completion: The keg fizzles slightly as the Disarming Mixture settles in.

304.name: A Grim Task
desc: Kill Balgaras the Foul and bring his ear to Longbraid the Grim outside of Dun Modr.
objectives: Kill Balgaras the Foul and bring his ear to Longbraid the Grim outside of Dun Modr.
details: Many of my soldiers died in the battle of Dun Modr. My own brother perished when the West Bridge over the Thandol Span was destroyed. Aye, the Dark Iron dwarves are a devilish breed. From what Roggo was able to gather, the leader of the thugs in the Wetlands is a warlock named Balgaras the Foul. He is quite a coward, sending his soldiers to do his bidding but hides in his camp on Direforge Hill, to the southeast.
BIf you can find the spineless scum, slay him and bring me his ear. I will reward you, $c.
completion: Balgaras the Foul is finally dead. While his death will not bring back the many innocent dwarves who died needlessly by his hand, it will help to restore peace of mind to those who survived. With Balgaras dead, the remaining Dark Iron scum should be easy enough to manage. Now, we must wipe them out before a new leader is sent to these parts.
BYou have done well, $C.

328.name: The Hidden Key
desc: Use the Small Brass Key to open Bookie Herod's Strongbox.
objectives: Use the Small Brass Key to open Bookie Herod's Strongbox.
details: Although no mention of Private Thorsen is found in these records, hidden within the binding of one of Herod's ledger books is a small, brass key.

BAnd after further study of his notes, a few references to a "secure strongbox" are contained among various papers. The box is somewhere within the Stockpile - the cavern complex at the back of Kurzen's Compound.
BIf this secure strongbox is found, and the small brass key can open it, then perhaps the mystery behind Thorsen's detection will be revealed.
completion: Opening the strongbox, it's clear that this is where Herod keeps his more valuable coins and items.

376.name: The Damned
desc: Novice Elreth requires 6 Scavenger Paws and 6 Duskbat Wings.
objectives: Novice Elreth requires 6 Scavenger Paws and 6 Duskbat Wings.
details: My duties include tending to our wounded warriors, tailoring armor and clothes, and assisting Shadow Priest Sarvis with whatever else he might need.

BFrom the look of it, you'll be enlisted in his service also... hunting the Mindless Ones, if I know his mind. Well, if you'd like to stay in one piece--and I've no doubt you do--perhaps I can help. I'm running out of paws and wings, and if you bring me some, I'll find some armor for you. You'll find a good number of wolves and bats to the south.
completion: Thank you, $N. This armor should help you out.
BHopefully, it should do you more good than the last one to wear it...

400.name: Tools for Steelgrill
desc: Deliver Steelgrill's Tools to Beldin Steelgrill.
objectives: Deliver Steelgrill's Tools to Beldin Steelgrill.
details: Beldin Steelgrill owns the local mechanic shop, and he's the best siege engine tech there is! But he's not forgiving to his tools. I swear he almost breaks more arclight spanners than we can supply him with!
BWe just filled his last order for tools. If you deliver it to him I'm sure he'll make it worth the effort.
BHis shop, Steelgrill's Depot, is just northeast of Kharanos. And it's a local haunt for veteran siege engine pilots, so keep your ears open for opportunities while you're there.
completion: You have my tools? Well done, lad, well done! I just broke my last fang-ratchet an hour ago and I need one of those to finish repairs on Pilot Stonegear's siege engine. You did a good thing by lugging those tools here, $N.
BHere, take these coins for your help.

424.name: Arugal's Folly
desc: Kill Grimson the Pale and bring his head to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
objectives: Kill Grimson the Pale and bring his head to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
details: It will indeed take me longer than I had thought to uncover the dark secrets behind the enchantments Arugal was using.
BBut in the meantime I need you to take care of a slight problem our Darkstalkers have discovered. It seems that Arugal let his magic spread to the Deep Elem Mine in the hills to the southeast.
BThe mine would prove to be quite a resource for Varimathras's advance.
BI want you to behead the tainted foreman of the mine, Grimson the Pale. With his death, the mine shall be ours.
completion: Most excellent. The mine will provide superb resources for our forces as we spread throughout Silverpine and into Azeroth.

448.name: Report to Hadrec
desc: Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
objectives: Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
details: Before you launch an assault on Fenris Isle, report to High Executor Hadrec. He may have additional information or equipment you'll need.
completion: If what Bethor says is true then Thule Ravenclaw is a force that must be dealt with, and dealt with soon.
BTo aid in this task, you may take something from our arsenal here...

472.name: Fall of Dun Modr
desc: Search for Longbraid near the town of Dun Modr.
objectives: Search for Longbraid near the town of Dun Modr.
details: Dun Modr has fallen to the Dark Iron Dwarves!
BMy wounds are grave, $c. Most of the regiment was killed! The Dark Iron thugs attacked us before we could regroup from the Thandol Span ambush.
BOur leader, Longbraid, sounded the retreat horn. As we left the town I was hit by a stray axe in the back. All went black.
BI awoke here in Menethil but I fear for my fellow soldiers. Hope still burns within me. Perhaps Longbraid is still alive! See if you can find him near Dun Modr, $r!
completion: What brave $C sends word from Menethil? Ah $N, they call you.

BYou bring hope to a hopeless situation. 'Tis good news indeed that young Harlo survived. While fleeing he received a grievous wound. We had but little time to send him on his way on the back of the only surviving steed with the regiment.
BBut now we face a perilous situation. Dun Modr has fallen and we are but a shadow of the great regiment we once were.

496.name: Elixir of Suffering
desc: Apothecary Lydon of Tarren Mill wants 10 Gray Bear Tongues and some Creeper Ichor.
objectives: Apothecary Lydon of Tarren Mill wants 10 Gray Bear Tongues and some Creeper Ichor.
details: Ah, another wretched day in Tarren Mill. All of this clean air puts me in such a foul mood, $N.
BThe sooner we can plague the humans here, the better. I've been conducting intense studies on possible killing agents to use in my concoctions but I haven't the time to collect them all.

BIf you want to make yourself of use, procure the following items for me: 10 Gray Bear Tongues and the very rare and hard to find, Creeper Ichor. You'll find both bears and creepers just outside of Tarren Mill.
completion: These specimens are perfect. Well, $N, you have managed to bring me the slightest hint of joy on yet another miserable day. Your efforts are appreciated.

520.name: The Crown of Will
desc: Kill Mug'Thol, and return his head with the Crown of Will to Melisara in Tarren Mill.
objectives: Kill Mug'Thol, and return his head with the Crown of Will to Melisara in Tarren Mill.
details: With Mug'Thol's lieutenants dead, all that remains is to kill Mug'Thol and retrieve the Crown of Will. I have no doubt he'll be reluctant to part with it. Most likely expecting you, too, given the... departure... of his fellows.
BFind Mug'Thol, and deliver his head and the Crown to me. The Crushridge resistance will be at an end.
completion: You have done your duty well, $N. Mug'Thol's head shall adorn the highest peak of the ruins of Alterac, and the Deathguard will sweep the remnants of the Crushridge into the ground.

544.name: Prison Break In
desc: Find the traitors and recover their artifacts, then return to Magus Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
objectives: Find the traitors and recover their artifacts, then return to Magus Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
details: I came to Tarren Mill to research, but now must resolve a crisis. You see, four Forsaken fled the Undercity a few months ago. They turned their backs on their brethren, but what's worse...they stole from the Dark Lady.
BThese thieves broke into a secure vault and stole four artifacts, items our apothecaries required in certain studies. Sylvanas would have these artifacts returned.
BThe thieves fled the Undercity to Dalaran, and those wizards quarantined them in the Lordamere Internment Camp.
completion: You have done a great service for the Forsaken, $N. These artifacts have been sorely missed.
BAnd it is good to hear that Kegan and the other betrayers have found justice.

568.name: The Defense of Grom'gol
desc: Commander Aggro'gosh of the Grom'gol base camp wants you to kill 15 Lashtail Raptors.
objectives: Commander Aggro'gosh of the Grom'gol base camp wants you to kill 15 Lashtail Raptors.
details: Throm'ka, $c!

BYour arrival at Grom'gol is timely, indeed. As commander of the Warchief's base camp here in the jungle I am bound by honor to ensure the safety of all members of the Horde. Our mission to provide a safe chain of supply to Stonard is being hampered by some of the local inhabitants.
BI am putting you in charge of thinning out the raptor population outside of Grom'gol. Once you have made significant progress, report back to me for reassignment.
completion: Your duty was performed with honor, $C.

592.name: Saving Yenniku
desc: Bring the Filled Soul Gem to Nimboya.
objectives: Bring the Filled Soul Gem to Nimboya.
details: I have reshaped the Mind's Eye into a Soul Gem. Its purpose is twofold: you must use it to stun Yenniku, and once stunned place it upon his head to entrap his soul.
BThen, bring the gem to Nimboya.
BYenniku dwells with Zanzil the Outcast, at the Ruins of Aboraz, along the Crystal Shore on the distant Cape of Stranglethorn.
completion: You've done it! You freed Yenniku from the will of Zanzil, and completed the mission I had thought was so desperate.
BOur tribe will remember your name in songs, $N, and we will etch your tale in stone so that it will live forever.

616.name: The Haunted Isle
desc: Speak with Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.
objectives: Speak with Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.
details: Baron Revilgaz has had me keep an ear out for rumors of the strange and out-of-place in Booty Bay and Stranglethorn. I don't usually put much stock in ghost stories, but I heard some sailors in the tavern talking about a haunted island off the coast. Water elementals and a raving goblin ghost, they say.
BIf you're going to go talk to Revilgaz, could you relay that story to him?
completion: Interesting. Some time ago, I seem to remember reading a book once that suggested...
BAh, of course, a troll legend it was. If what Krazek reports is true, perhaps I will soon be able to add the Stone of the Tides to my collection of ancient artifacts and relics.

640.name: The Broken Sigil
desc: Retrieve the 5 Sigil Fragments from the defenders in Stromgarde, and bring them to Tor'gan in Hammerfall.
objectives: Retrieve the 5 Sigil Fragments from the defenders in Stromgarde, and bring them to Tor'gan in Hammerfall.
details: Thoras Trollbane's tomb is protected by three sigils--the first of which you retrieved from the Syndicate. The other two will be harder to get, as they're held by the firmly entrenched Stromgarde militia.

BThe sigil of Thoradin was divided into five pieces by Thoras' son, Galen, and dispersed among the Stromgarde defenders. Retrieve the pieces and bring them to Tor'gan, the troll shaman, he will be able to bind them into the complete sigil.
completion: Ah, you need me to reconstruct this sigil? It shouldn't be too difficult... all the pieces seem to be here and the magical structure will be easy to reform.
BYou might want to close your eyes.

664.name: Drowned Sorrows
desc: Captain Steelgut in Faldir's Cove wants you to kill 10 Daggerspine Raiders and 3 Daggerspine Sorceresses.
objectives: Captain Steelgut in Faldir's Cove wants you to kill 10 Daggerspine Raiders and 3 Daggerspine Sorceresses.
details: Argh, 'tis a horrible life. I should be in a watery grave right now, not sittin' here by the fire, breathin' fresh air.
BThe crew tried so hard to save my beautiful Maiden's Folly. Bless the boys, bless their hearts.
BO'Breen made it to shore safely but we weren't so lucky. The seas just sank on us, I swear.
BOne second we're afloat and the next water is rushin' in. And those beasts! Killed all the survivors. Horrible naga scum. I went black and ended up here, saved.
BI want those beasts dead.
completion: Nice work out there, $N.
BThose scum deserved what they got. While nothin' will ever bring me ship or me crew back, the death of those naga gives me some solace.

688.name: Myzrael's Allies
desc: Speak with Zaruk in Hammerfall.
objectives: Speak with Zaruk in Hammerfall.
details: <Myzrael speaks.>
BFree! I AM FREE! I am free to gather strength, hidden from my captors. For if they faced me now they would surely overpower and again imprison me.
BBut in time I will confront the giants, and they will regret their wardship of me!
BYou are a noble ally, $N. I will need your help again in time. When I am ready, I will need you to summon me to the surface
BSpeak with Zaruk in Hammerfall. He knows how I can be summoned.
completion: Welcome, $C. The Lady has informed me of your coming, and if we are to bring her back to the surface then we have much to discuss...

712.name: Study of the Elements: Rock
desc: Bring 5 Bracers of Rock Binding to Lotwil Veriatus in the Badlands.
objectives: Bring 5 Bracers of Rock Binding to Lotwil Veriatus in the Badlands.
details: $N, there's one more part I need from the elementals here in the Badlands: the bracers of rock binding from the greater rock elementals. By my calculations, those bracers should be enough to gauge the strength of my own shackles.
BMy attempts at scrying the greater rock elementals showed a group of them southwest of here, near some ogres if I recall.
BBring me 5 of their bracers just so I have extras. Servo's notorious for misplacing my reagents and research.
completion: $N, have you ever considered becoming a research assistant? No? I'm not sure what I'll do without your abilities here. Intelligence, curiosity, and strength--all combined into one package.

736.name: The Star, the Hand and the Heart
desc: Bring the items on Bel'dugur's Note to Keeper Bel'dugur in the Undercity.
objectives: Bring the items on Bel'dugur's Note to Keeper Bel'dugur in the Undercity.
details: You need Yagyin's Digest? Your plan, then, is to gather another flock? Of course it is...and of course I will help you, $gbrother:sister;.
BBut you must help me too.
BI require three items of power. Bring me these and the digest will be yours.
BI cannot utter the names of these items, but I will write them down.
BGet me the items on this list. If you can do that, then you are truly worthy of opening your own chapter of our order.
completion: I am impressed! You possess great skill, or great fortune, to have gained these relics. Either way, you are an asset to us.

760.name: Wildmane Cleansing
desc: Use the Wildmane Cleansing Totem at the Wildmane Water Well, then return to Mull Thunderhorn.
objectives: Use the Wildmane Cleansing Totem at the Wildmane Water Well, then return to Mull Thunderhorn.
details: Your cleansing of the Winterhoof and Thunderhorn wells is spoken among the spirits, young $N. The Wildmane Totem is made, and your last task lies ahead.
BThe Wildmane Water Well lies north of Thunder Bluff. Perform the ritual! Heal the land of the goblins' poisons! Let clean water flow once again!
completion: You've done it. You have cleaned the wells, and healed our land. Bloodhoof village is grateful, $N.
BMay the wind whisper your deeds for a hundred seasons, and may the waters of Mulgore remain clean forever.

784.name: Vanquish the Betrayers
desc: Kill 10 Kul Tiras Sailors, 8 Kul Tiras Marines and Lieutenant Benedict and return to Gar'Thok in Razor Hill.
objectives: Kill 10 Kul Tiras Sailors, 8 Kul Tiras Marines and Lieutenant Benedict and return to Gar'Thok in Razor Hill.
details: Led by Admiral Proudmoore, the humans of Kul Tiras encroached on Durotar, violating the Warchief's pact made with Jaina Proudmoore in order to defeat Archimonde years ago.

BThe human aggression was repelled and Tiragarde Keep fell. But recently, the Admiral's reserves, led by Lieutenant Benedict, have retaken the keep and once again pose a threat to our homeland. These humans show no respect for diplomacy.
BProve your honor and travel south to Tiragarde Keep to eliminate the human invaders.
completion: Word of your bravery travels fast, $C. Tales of your victory at Tiragarde Keep will be heralded in Orgrimmar.

808.name: Minshina's Skull
desc: Retrieve Minshina's skull from the circle of power on the Echo Isles.
Bring it to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
objectives: Retrieve Minshina's skull from the circle of power on the Echo Isles.
BBring it to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
details: I hear the voice of my brother, Minshina, calling to me in my dreams.
BHe was taken by Zalazane, the warlock on the Echo Isles to the east. And he is dead.

BBut death is not freedom for my brother. Minshina's spirit was trapped within his own skull by Zalazane's magics. In my dreams I see it with other skulls, in a circle of power on the largest Echo Isle. As long as it remains there my brother's soul is doomed.
BPlease, $N. Find the circle and retrieve Minshina's skull. Bring it to me.
BFree him!
completion: Thank you, $N. You have saved Minshina. You have saved my brother's spirit from slavery!

832.name: Burning Shadows
desc: Take this eye to Neeru Fireblade.
objectives: Take this eye to Neeru Fireblade.
details: <Words emanate from the pendant and into your mind.>
BGazz'uz?
BGazz'uz...report!
BThere is word of your discovery in Skull Rock. You must prepare for an attack!
BGazz'uz, I order you to speak! Speak or I will make sure Neeru Fireblade knows of your presence, and he will descend on you with swift brutality.
BDo not test your skills against Neeru...
B...Gazz'uz, are you there...?
completion: <Examines the Eye of Burning Shadow>

BIntriguing. The voice you heard mentioned my name? I am known for hunting down enemies of our Warchief, but...it is strange that I was singled out. Stranger still that the Burning Blade cultists from whom you recovered this pendant have a name so close to my own.
BI must study this pendant. I must study and, and must ponder the meaning of its message.
BThank you for bringing this to my attention, $N. You have done your people a great service.

880.name: Altered Beings
desc: Bring 8 Altered Snapjaw Shells to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads.
objectives: Bring 8 Altered Snapjaw Shells to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads.
details: Your findings are incredible, $N. These oases hold properties that must come from an outside source. Or perhaps an inside one.
BI want to know how these fissures are affecting the beasts who drink from the oases' water.
BHunt oasis snapjaws at the Lushwater and Stagnant Oases. Bring me their shells so I may examine them.
completion: Thank you, $N. Studying the beasts of an area can tell much about the area itself. We shall see what tale these shells tell.
BPlease accept my gratitude for your aid ... and perhaps you can use these coins. I find that I do not need them.

928.name: Crown of the Earth
desc: Bring the Partially Filled Vessel to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar.
objectives: Bring the Partially Filled Vessel to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar.
details: While there is more I could speak to you of the moonwells and of Teldrassil, I must send you along. Corithras Moonrage will be expecting you. I have poured the phial of water you brought to me into this vessel to bring to him.
BSeek out Corithras. You will find him at the moonwell in Dolanaar. Follow the road south from Aldrassil out of Shadowglen, and continue to follow the cobblestones as the road turns west.
BMind you stay on the road though, $n. There are dangerous beasts in the forests of late.
completion: Ah, I see. You were sent by Tenaron. Well then, it would seem we have much to talk about, much to do, and little time to do it in.
BI think we'd best get started.

952.name: Grove of the Ancients
desc: Deliver Fandral's message to Onu in the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore, south of Auberdine.
objectives: Deliver Fandral's message to Onu in the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore, south of Auberdine.
details: If you had enough time to run messages for the Oracle Tree, then I'm sure that I can press you into service to deliver a message to the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore, due south of Auberdine.

BYou will most likely have to secure transport on a hippogryph, but I have faith enough in you that you can manage that. Take this to Onu, the Ancient of Lore. He has been awaiting word from me, even as I waited for news from the Oracle Glade.
completion: Ah. Thank you, $N. It is strange, though. The Arch Druid always seems in such a hurry. The forest knows that all shall come to pass in the appointed time. Shan'do Stormrage understood that.

976.name: Supplies to Auberdine
desc: Speak with Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post after seeing Feero safely through Ashenvale Forest.
objectives: Speak with Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post after seeing Feero safely through Ashenvale Forest.
details: Delgren has asked me to deliver messages and supplies to Sentinel Starbreeze in Auberdine, but I am loathe to leave on my own. Dangerous foes operate in the forest, and I do not wish to risk letting these supplies and information fall into the wrong hands.
BIf you and others could act as my guards, I could leave now. With your protection, I have no doubt that we can see these goods safely to Auberdine.
completion: You have done well today, $C. The items we sent to aid Auberdine will be of immediate use in dealing with the dark threats that infest the forest.
BTake these with my heartfelt thanks.

1000.name: The New Frontier
desc: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.
objectives: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.
details: Attention, heroes!

BThe Cenarion Circle seeks able bodied individuals to assist them in exploring the vast new frontiers of Kalimdor! A forbidden wasteland of unimaginable dangers lies far to the west of Tanaris and Gadgetzan, and the Circle needs willing and honorable proxies to act in their stead.
BAll interested individuals should seek audience with the Cenarion Circle. Speak with the Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder's Rise of Thunder Bluff for more information!
completion: Greetings, $C.

BI am pleased to see the likes of you taking an interest in the well being of nature; tales of your mighty deeds precede you, and you are welcomed here. Seeing you before me instills the feeling of confidence that the Cenarion Circle will get the proper aid it needs.
BOur connection with the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade transcends racial and political divides. Remember this as you work on behalf of the Circle, and you will do well.

1024.name: Raene's Cleansing
desc: Find Shael'dryn at the moonwell to the northeast.
objectives: Find Shael'dryn at the moonwell to the northeast.
details: You'll have to do the research yourself, but from what notes Teronis has made, it sounds like your next course of action is to find the other pieces of the rod Dartol created. I would start by heading to the moonwell east of Iris Lake. When you're ready, follow the road and turn north when you reach a small sitting area on your left.
BA dryad there named Shael'dryn is better suited to guide you. Seek her out.
BKeep the gem with you--Shael'dryn will need it if she's to help you recreate the rod.
completion: Oh, Raene sent you? It must be serious indeed. What can I help you with?

1048.name: Into The Scarlet Monastery
desc: Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod, the Scarlet Champion and Houndmaster Loksey and then report back to Varimathras in the Undercity.
objectives: Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod, the Scarlet Champion and Houndmaster Loksey and then report back to Varimathras in the Undercity.
details: Whilst the Dark Lady tends to the pressing issue of the Lich King's advance to the north, I am seeing to it that matters closer to home are being taken care of accordingly.
BNo doubt, the human pests who call themselves the Scarlet Crusade are proving to be the sharpest thorn in our side domestically. Tirisfal Glades is literally crawling with the little red ants.
BTravel to the Monastery, $c, and lay waste to High Inquisitor Whitemane and her top lieutenants.
completion: You have served the Dark Lady well, $c. 'Twas no small task I asked of you.
BYour loyalty to the Forsaken has been noted. And your tenacity in combat will be remembered.

1072.name: An Old Colleague
desc: Speak to Lomac Gearstrip in Ironforge.
objectives: Speak to Lomac Gearstrip in Ironforge.
details: The device I'm thinking about is my most advanced version to date. But we'll need a special potion if it's to work. I'm thinking we might as well get the good stuff since this mission could be your last.
BAnd for that, we're going to need some potent explosives: Nitromirglyceronium.
BThe only person who can make NG-5 is an old friend of mine: Lomac Gearstrip. Look for him in Tinker Town.
BYou talk him into making us some NG-5, I'll get to work on placement for my devices.
completion: Ahhh. Gaxim sent you, huh? How do I know you're not lying to me?! Hmm? Hmm?

1096.name: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle
desc: Bring Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle's Mechanical Arm to Ziz Fizziks in the Stonetalon Mountains.
objectives: Bring Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle's Mechanical Arm to Ziz Fizziks in the Stonetalon Mountains.
details: I met Gerenzo once, but let me tell you, he's not easy on the eyes. His flesh looks like it's rotting away, and he's grafted metal and gears onto his body, replaced some of his limbs with mechanical ones.

BNortheast of here, far above Cragpool Lake, up near the water wheel is where Gerenzo watches over the entire site. There's no way I could fight my way up there, not to mention take on Gerenzo... But you look like you might be able to make it.
BIf you kill him for me, I'll make it worth your while!
completion: Look at that thing... it'd take a gnome to come up with something like that. I can't understand why you'd cut off an arm, and replace it with that, when you could just keep both arms and add a third!
BGnomes, I tell you...
BAt least Gerenzo's out of commission. Hopefully that'll be enough proof, and Sputtervalve will assign me to one of the Tinkers' Union workshops in Gadgetzan or maybe even Undermine.

1120.name: Get the Gnomes Drunk
desc: Bring the Fool's Stout to the Gnome Pit Boss.
objectives: Bring the Fool's Stout to the Gnome Pit Boss.
details: We need to try the Fool's Stout on one of the pit crews. If you want to try it on the gnomes, then here -- take the stout and give it to the gnome pit boss.
BAnd don't wait too long. This stout will go bad eventually.
completion: Stout? How considerate! Thank you!
BWe shouldn't be drinking with the race coming up, but... maybe my boys could do with just a little. Besides, it can't be that strong, can it?

1144.name: Willix the Importer
desc: Escort Willix the Importer out of Razorfen Kraul.
objectives: Escort Willix the Importer out of Razorfen Kraul.
details: At last, help has arrived!
BYou have no clue how long I've been held prisoner here. I can't remember the last time I saw the outside of this place.

BYou see, I am an entrepreneur. Always out for a copper, as they say. I caught wind that Mebok Mizzyrix was paying well for Blueleaf Tuber from this here pig pen. I figured it would be an easy in, easy out kind of affair. As you can see, I was a bit wrong!
BAnyway, if you'd be so kind as to help me get out of here, I'll make it worth your while.
completion: Thanks again, friend! I told you I'd make it worth your while.

1168.name: Army of the Black Dragon
desc: Tharg in Brackenwall Village wants you to kill 10 Firemane Scouts, 10 Firemane Ash Tails, and 5 Firemane Scalebanes.
objectives: Tharg in Brackenwall Village wants you to kill 10 Firemane Scouts, 10 Firemane Ash Tails, and 5 Firemane Scalebanes.
details: Mok'Morokk was made Overlord by Rexxar. He care more for power than he care for ogres.
BBlack dragons kill many ogre. Kill Tharg's wife. Mok'Morokk tell us to run. Make us come here.
BOgre should fight. Ogres not good at running. Mok'Morokk care only about Mok'Morokk.
BMe call Stonemaul Ruins home. Me like it in the south. This place not home.
BHelp ogres fight army of the black dragon. Me want revenge. Me want to go home.
completion: You kill many of the black dragon army. You brave $r.
BMake Tharg happy.

1240.name: The Troll Witchdoctor
desc: Take the Defiant Orc Head to Kin'weelay in the Grom'gol Base Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.
objectives: Take the Defiant Orc Head to Kin'weelay in the Grom'gol Base Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.
details: We must know the events surrounding Marg's death! And the only way to do that, $N, is through the witch-magic of trolls.
BBring Marg's head to Kin'weelay in Stranglethorn Vale, at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
BKin'weelay is the most powerful witchdoctor of the Darkspear trolls. If anyone can speak to Marg Nighteye's spirit, it is he.
completion: Ah, I now see. The spirit of this orc is bound in our world, boiling with rage from a task yet undone.
BWell, let us have words with this angry orc...

1264.name: The Missing Diplomat
desc: Find Commander Samaul in Dustwallow Marsh.
objectives: Find Commander Samaul in Dustwallow Marsh.
details: The beginning of every month the Kul Tiras Marines all get paid and usually leave Theramore for somewhere else. A lot of them come here to womanize, carouse, and just have a good time. One of those groups I'd consider regulars here at the tavern, and I believe this Hendel is among them.

BCommander Samaul in Theramore would be able to help you find him if Hendel's still stationed there. He's completely loyal to Proudmoore, but if you drop Elling's name, he should help you out... discreetly.
completion: A pleasure to meet you, $N. I am Commander Samaul. I'm in charge of Miss Proudmoore's forces here in Theramore.
BAlthough I'm quite busy, if you have any questions, please feel free to speak up. I might have to keep it short, but there's no reason for me to be rude if you need my help.
BIf you plan on traveling out of the city, I'd suggest you be careful. Besides ogres, orcs and murlocs, the southern part of the swamp is filled with black dragons.

1360.name: Reclaimed Treasures
desc: Get Krom Stoutarm's treasured possession from his chest in the North Common Hall of Uldaman, and bring it to him in Ironforge.
objectives: Get Krom Stoutarm's treasured possession from his chest in the North Common Hall of Uldaman, and bring it to him in Ironforge.
details: I had myself a fine job as a digger at the Uldaman excavation site in the Badlands... that is until those blasted troggs showed up. I escaped with my hide barely intact, and nothing else. In the chaos, I left my most treasured possession. It's safe from the troggs in my chest, sure, but it's right in the thick of 'em.
BI'd be in your debt, both in honor and coin, if you could fetch it for me! A chest with my name on it is at the end of the North Common Hall. That's the one you need to get in.
completion: Ah, I feel complete again - thank you kindly.
BSome dwarves may treasure the luster of metal, and some may treasure the glint of gems... but a Stoutarm without a treasured stein in hand is hardly a Stoutarm at all!

1384.name: Raid on the Kolkar
desc: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring 10 Crude Charms to Uthek the Wise in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.
objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring 10 Crude Charms to Uthek the Wise in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.
details: The Kolkar centaurs think their magic is strong. They do not know magic! They would not know magic if it bit them!
BYou will show them their magic is weak. Go to the Kolkar to the northeast and kill them. Take their charms. Bring me the charms and I will throw them in the fire and laugh!
completion: You do a good thing for the Gelkis. The Kolkar are weak and will die. Their magic is pathetic and will not save them. You showed them this, and their fear will make them even more feeble!
BAnd in our lands, the feeble soon die.

1432.name: Alliance Relations
desc: Speak to Takata Steelblade in Desolace.
objectives: Speak to Takata Steelblade in Desolace.
details: As the Alliance progresses deeper and deeper into Kalimdor, incorrect conclusions may be drawn about the Horde making pacts with the Burning Legion. The Warchief cannot allow that to happen. And with his blessing, I am taking control of overseeing them removed.

BI have agents in the area of Desolace at the Ghost Walker Post north of the great Kodo Graveyard. Head south of the Charred Vale in the Stonetalon Mountains and you shall come across it. When you arrive, seek out Takata Steelblade.
completion: Greetings, $C. You bring news from Orgrimmar; that is good.

BThe demon infestation overwhelms this area even more than the smell of centaur dung. The horse-men claim this land as their own, but clearly there are influences out of their control that will crush them if not kept in check.
BIt does not please me that we aid the centaur indirectly, but it is for the good of the Horde, so I do my duty for the Warchief, even if it means helping the warlocks within the Horde.

1456.name: The Karnitol Shipwreck
desc: Find Karnitol's Satchel and return it to Kreldig Ungor in Desolace.
objectives: Find Karnitol's Satchel and return it to Kreldig Ungor in Desolace.
details: Intriguing.
BWell, we might not be without hope quite yet.

BAlong that same coast, but to the north near Ranazjar Isle, there're night elf ruins at the bottom of the ocean. A tribe of naga, the Slitherblade, make that their home. I think that'd be our best bet.
BIf a scouting party went that far south, then they must've been pretty powerful. If you're gonna find Karnitol's belongings, I'd start with the more powerful naga: the tidehunters or sea witches.
completion: This is great, $N! You found Karnitol's belongings!
BThose blasted naga, always causing trouble. I think I'd rather spend my life at war with the Horde than have to go against their kind. You've done a great service to the Reclaimers.

1480.name: The Corrupter
desc: Bring the Flayed Demon Skin to Maurin Bonesplitter in Desolace.
objectives: Bring the Flayed Demon Skin to Maurin Bonesplitter in Desolace.
details: The torn skin smells rotten, and is remarkably pliable for something that appears to be dry and fragile.
BAs you unroll it, you can clearly see the red markings of some kind of language on one side. At the bottom of the skin is a very clear symbol that you guess is a signature of some kind.
BPerhaps it is something Maurin could tell you more about?
completion: Hmm, these runes are indeed a language, $N, an old language. They seem remotely similar to the Eredun language, but the differences are drastic. If I am not mistaken, this is a contract of some kind.... Here, yes, this symbol is the demon's signature: Lord Azrethoc.

1504.name: The Binding
desc: Using the Glyphs of Summoning, summon and subdue a voidwalker, then return the Glyphs of Summoning to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Using the Glyphs of Summoning, summon and subdue a voidwalker, then return the Glyphs of Summoning to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
details: Now, observe the Tablet of Verga, for it contains the glyphs you will need for the summoning. Take them to the circle in Neeru Fireblade's tent on the other side of the cavern. There you will be able to call for the voidwalker.

BYou must defeat it using whatever physical and magical means you have at your disposal. When this is completed, return to me with the glyphs of summoning and I will demonstrate how you may bind the creature to your will.
completion: You have done well, $N. I will show you how to summon the voidwalker similar to the one you just defeated.
BYou should know that we have high expectations for you, and you have, so far, matched them.
BDo not let it go to your head, however, as the tasks that still lie before you will make this seem as simple as waking in the morning.

1528.name: Call of Water
desc: Find Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.
objectives: Find Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.
details: Water be in ya future, mon. I see you be strong in da ways of fire already, an' me tinkin' you be ready to talk to Islen.

BIslen live along the coast of da Barrens. If ya head south along the Southfury River, ya canna miss her--look fer da big shark! She be strong in da ways of da elements and can teach ya da ways of water... if you tink you be ready.
BShe be easy ta find, just don' go too far south--she be jus' beyond Ratchet.
completion: The wind approaches you quickly from the horizon; the earth is steady beneath your feet; and your spirit is already warmed by fire--I would say it is time for you to learn about the purity of water.
BYour path has led you this far, and your spirit will give you the strength to carry on even further. But the first step is yours to take.

1648.name: The Tome of Divinity
desc: Bring 10 Linen Cloth to John Turner in Ironforge.
objectives: Bring 10 Linen Cloth to John Turner in Ironforge.
details: My wife and I run an orphanage in Stormwind, mostly for children who have lost parents due to the attacks by the Scourge in the last decade. I come to Ironforge every month or so to see about collecting more supplies from the citizens here, and talk to the various groups to see if they can do anything to help.
BThis trip's been agonizingly slow, and not very productive.
BIf I could just get some more linen for my wife to make some clothes, I could finally send a shipment home.
completion: This is so wonderful of you, $N. Thank you again.

BYou're a noble man for doing this for me. It's no wonder you've chosen to follow the Light. I wish there was some way I could repay you for all you've done... what's that? It's the least you could do? See? That's what I'm talking about, $N, noble to the end.
BBe safe, and may the Light protect you in your travels.

1792.name: Whirlwind Weapon
completion: I have the whirlwind heart, and am ready to place it within your vessel of choice.
BChoose your weapon, $N, and know that its power is the power of Cyclonian.

1840.name: Orm Stonehoof and the Brutal Helm
desc: Speak with Orm Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Speak with Orm Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
details: Orm Stonehoof is respected greatly for his skill. He will make for you the brutal helm.
BSeek him out in Thunder Bluff, near the pool by the city's great, central totem.
completion: Greetings, warrior. I am Orm, and Thun'grim tells me you wish a helm made?

1960.name: Investigate the Alchemist Shop
desc: Obtain a Cantation of Manifestation and a Chest of Containment Coffers from behind Anastasia Hartwell. Bring 3 Filled Containment Coffers, the Chest of Containment Coffers and the Cantation of Manifestation to Anastasia in the Undercity.
objectives: Obtain a Cantation of Manifestation and a Chest of Containment Coffers from behind Anastasia Hartwell. Bring 3 Filled Containment Coffers, the Chest of Containment Coffers and the Cantation of Manifestation to Anastasia in the Undercity.
details: Algernon's alchemist shop in the Apothecarium is the locus of a strange disturbance. Invisible creatures, made solely of magic, wander the shop--there must be a reason, and we must find it!

BInvestigate the disturbance and capture those creatures. Take a chest of coffers and a scroll from behind me. Use the scroll at the shop to make the creatures visible, subdue them with your spells, then throw down a coffer to capture them. Return with the filled coffers, the empty coffers and the cantation.
completion: Very good, $N. The creatures within these containment coffers will be studied by our finest minds, and the reason behind their presence in the Undercity will be determined.

BIf their appearance is caused by a rift in the natural flow of magic, then we must determine if the rift was random. If it was not random, but instead an attack by some magical force, then we must prepare for future, more serious disturbances.

2200.name: Back to Uldaman
desc: Search for clues as to the current disposition of Talvash's necklace within Uldaman. The slain paladin he mentioned was the person who had it last.
objectives: Search for clues as to the current disposition of Talvash's necklace within Uldaman. The slain paladin he mentioned was the person who had it last.
details: A competitor of mine started a rumor that my necklace cursed the paladin. Needless to say, no one wants to buy cursed items from a jeweler.
B$N, I'll make you a deal - find the gems and I'll reassemble the necklace, so long as you'll advertise that I do NOT make cursed items!

BTry looking for clues in Uldaman; maybe see if the paladin's body is down there, since he's the one who we know had it last! When you find the gems you should use this; it'll allow you to contact me here in Ironforge.
completion: Remains of a paladin: Reading the journal reveals that after much effort, the paladin had identified the location of all three missing gems:
BThe Shadowforge dwarves hid the ruby in their barricaded area as they battled the Troggs for control of Uldaman.
BThe troggs stashed the topaz in an urn located near some unusual inhabitants of Uldaman - Alliance dwarves!
BFinally, the trogg elder himself took the sapphire as his own.

2440.name: The Platinum Discs
desc: Take the reward voucher to Bena Winterhoof in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Take the reward voucher to Bena Winterhoof in Thunder Bluff.
details: I shall focus my energies on these discs; they will reveal their true workings to me in due time.

BAs for you $N, I will now reward you for your diligence in bringing this to my attention. Take this voucher to Bena Winterhoof, the alchemy trainer for Thunder Bluff. She will give you a special item I believe you will find appealing, and she will supply you with a choice of potions from my personal stock.
BReturn to me soon, as I sense there is much more at hand for us to do regarding this find.
completion: Well $N, you must have pleased Sage Truthseeker greatly for him to give you this item. You are also to be granted a gift from his cache of potions; you may choose between 5 superior healing potions or 5 greater mana potions as your reward.

2584.name: Spirit of the Boar
desc: Bring three Blasted Boar Lungs, two Scorpok Pincers, and one Basilisk Brain to Bloodmage Drazial.

2608.name: The Touch of Zanzil
desc: /Lay down to be examined by Doc Mixilpixil. How can he find the cure if he can't find the cause?
objectives: /Lay down to be examined by Doc Mixilpixil. How can he find the cure if he can't find the cause?$B
details: Oh my, you look like death. Correction - I've seen death, you look worse than death. You, $g sir:miss;, would be what death coughed up at his last physical.
BHah! You hear that Noarm? Write that one down!
B*Cough* Hrm yes, in order for me to help you, I'll need to draw some blood. Don't worry, it only hurts the first few... fifty times or so... /lay down when you're ready for the treatment, $N.
completion: Give me a moment to confer with my colleagues, $N. Dr. Montgomery, Mr. Noarm, let us conference!

2752.name: On Iron Pauldrons
desc: Bring four Bronze Battleaxes and four Bronze Warhammers to Orokk Omosh in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring four Bronze Battleaxes and four Bronze Warhammers to Orokk Omosh in Orgrimmar.
details: Orokk sees the eagerness in your eyes, $N. Like a sponge you soak in the wisdom of the Omosh.
BThree lessons I shall teach!
BReturn to the anvil, soak in the heat of the forge, create for Orokk four bronze battleaxes and four bronze warhammers. Only then will you learn of the iron pauldron.
completion: You do Orokk proud, $N. Read, learn of iron shoulders!

2848.name: Wild Leather Shoulders
desc: Bring 6 Thick Armor Kits and a Wildvine to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.
objectives: Bring 6 Thick Armor Kits and a Wildvine to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.
details: Wild Leather shoulders support the wearer's frame extremely well, offering top notch protection of the upper arms and the shoulders themselves. As with all Wild Leather armor, a potent but random benefit is applied to the item as the wildvine is stitched in.
BFor this pattern, I will require six thick armor kits and a wildvine. That shouldn't be too tall of an order for you to fill.
completion: These armor kits are of solid quality, $N. If there is one thing I demand in not only my work, but the work of those in my employ, it is quality.
BYou've done well to earn this pattern; I hope it brings you the rewards it has brought me.
BGains

2872.name: Stoley's Debt
desc: Speak with Stoley in Steamwheedle Port.
objectives: Speak with Stoley in Steamwheedle Port.
details: My old buddy Stoley owes me a very special bottle of rum. He tends the bar at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris, Kalimdor, and he promised me that the rum there is stronger than anything we can find in Booty Bay. He's so confident that he says if I try that rum and don't agree with him, then he'll double the money he owes me!
BWell, I think he's not as confident as he was when last we spoke, and now he's afraid to give me that rum. But I don't back down from wagers, so why don't you talk to him for me...
completion: Ah, so you've been speaking with MacKinley, have you?
BIt's not what he thinks! I'm not afraid to give him some Steamwheedle Bilge Rum...
BI just don't have any rum to give him!

2944.name: The Super Snapper FX
desc: Use the Super Snapper FX to take a snapshot of Gammerita, then return to Daryn Lightwind in Rut'theran Village.
objectives: Use the Super Snapper FX to take a snapshot of Gammerita, then return to Daryn Lightwind in Rut'theran Village.
details: Have the first look at my new invention, $N. All you need to do is target whatever it is you'd like to take a picture of, and push the button.
BWhat was that creature from the Hinterlands that you mentioned? Gammerita? Well, good luck finding her. I'm sure Daryn will be quite pleased with the snapshot you return to her.
BIn any case, here's the Super Snapper. Have fun!
completion: Well! Curgle's invention lived up to its expectations.
BDon't get too excited, but do know that I am pleased with your work, $N.
BNow, where did I leave that book...

2968.name: A Future Task
desc: Speak with Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Speak with Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff.
details: Well $n... we seem to be at an unfortunate impasse. We know what we need - the Plates of Uldum - but we have no idea where they might be. We will research this, and then devise a solid plan of attack. I have a couple ideas where to start looking; I have high hopes that soon, we'll be asking you to rejoin our efforts to discover the truth.
BSage Truthseeker needs to be informed on this, $n; no doubt, he also wants to thank you personally for once again heeding the call.
completion: We're all in agreement then - the best course of action is to wait until we can narrow down the areas where these plates might lie hidden. You've brought us this far $N, and I hope you will be the one to head back in to the field to confront the secrets of Uldum.

BAllow me to give you this honorarium in the meantime; this should cover any expenses you've encountered in assisting us, and a little something extra. Be sure to check back with us soon... Uldum beckons us all, young one.

2992.name: The Divination
desc: Wait until Grimshade performs the ritual of divination.
objectives: Wait until Grimshade performs the ritual of divination.
details: Give me room while I perform a ritual of divination. I will find the connection between the feather you brought me and its owner, and follow that connection to Sharpbeak himself.
BThat is... I will if all goes according to plan. If it does not, then... you better close your eyes.
completion: The ritual was a success. I have seen Sharpbeak and can tell you how to find him.

3088.name: Encrypted Parchment
desc: Read the Encrypted Parchment and speak to Rwag in the Valley of Trials.
objectives: Read the Encrypted Parchment and speak to Rwag in the Valley of Trials.
details: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, $N.
BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the rogue trainer Rwag. He would have words with you when you're ready.
completion: Now that you know where I'm holding up, I should let you know: the Shattered Hand's asked me to look out for you. They want me to train you and keep you informed of anything they might need. Even if you're not interested in helping them yet--which you'd be a fool not to be--I'll do what I can to train you... for a small fee. Come back to me anytime you think you're ready, and we'll see what you're ready to learn.

3112.name: Simple Memorandum
desc: Read the Simple Memorandum and speak to Thran Khorman in Coldridge Valley.
objectives: Read the Simple Memorandum and speak to Thran Khorman in Coldridge Valley.
details: While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the warrior trainer Thran. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
completion: Well, seein' how this is your prime directive, or whatever yer callin' it these days, I gave my word I'd do whatever I can to make sure you and yours were ready to take back your home... and that's just what I'm gonna do.
BAny time you feel yer ready, come back to good ol' Thran and I'll be happy to share my knowledge wit ya. There's some cost to me trainin' ya, but it won't be too expensive. Good luck.

3376.name: Break Sharptusk!
desc: Bring the head of Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle to Brave Windfeather in Red Cloud Mesa.
objectives: Bring the head of Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle to Brave Windfeather in Red Cloud Mesa.
details: $N - I have heard of you, newcomer. Perhaps it is you that will help us, where others have failed.

BWe tauren have carved a home out of this land, but not without a cost. The Bristleback quilboars of Brambleblade Ravine, led by Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle, have made our lives difficult with their continued war against us. I charge you to bring me the chief's head!
BHe will be found in the ravine to the east in their makeshift village.
completion: Justice has been served on this day by your swift actions, $N. Let this deed serve as a warning to all who would threaten our home.
BYou have earned this reward to help you on your sojourn, young $C.

3448.name: Passing the Burden
desc: Speak to Tymor in Ironforge.
objectives: Speak to Tymor in Ironforge.
details: I've recently been handed the responsibility of investigating Azshara--a once beautiful area the elves called home. This would be back when they practiced magic. It's now a more dangerous place than it is beautiful, but that doesn't stop us from turning over every stone for answers to our past.
BA companion of mine named Tymor offered to help me investigate the area since he takes a particular interest in such things.
BHe owns a small place to the right of the Hall of Mysteries here in the city.
completion: Ah, Karnik sent you, did he? I expected to hear from him soon. I've discovered such wonderful things about Azshara.. I know night elves have incredible life spans, but everyone forgets some of the more... unfortunate events in their lives sometimes. That's not meant as a criticism, just an observation.
BLong ago, there were cities created by the elves filled with knowledge about magic and other lost arts. Being a student of such things, I started my investigation. What I found was quite thrilling.

3520.name: Screecher Spirits
desc: Capture the spirits of 3 screechers in Feralas, then return to Yeh'kinya in Steamwheedle Port.
objectives: Capture the spirits of 3 screechers in Feralas, then return to Yeh'kinya in Steamwheedle Port.
details: I seek the spirits of the vale screechers of Feralas. They are the cousins of an old, old god, and their spirits are linked to him.

BTake this bramble wand and go to Feralas. Find and defeat vale screechers in southern and central Feralas, then wave my bramble over their fallen bodies. This will coax their spirit to reveal itself. Touch the spirit and collect its essence.
BReturn to me with my bramble and with the collected essence, and I will tell you more of the old god of which I spoke.
completion: You have done well, $N. Perhaps now it is time to reveal more...

BThere is an ancient prophecy among the trolls, where the dead god Hakkar, the Soulflayer, will one day return to this earth. Some say the coming of Hakkar will bring joy and glory to trollkind, while others believe his resurrection marks the end of all things.
BI do not believe this myth, but I do know the essence of Hakkar holds great power, and this power should be kept from those who would abuse it...

3568.name: Seeping Corruption
desc: Fill all 4 Empty Vials at the tide pools along the coast of the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara before returning to Chemist Cuely.
objectives: Fill all 4 Empty Vials at the tide pools along the coast of the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara before returning to Chemist Cuely.
details: See that tauren behind me--the one who looks like she's going to be ill at any moment? She was in Azshara recently. She claims she was wounded by some naga while making her way through the Ruins of Eldarath.
BAfter fighting off a few of them, she took a break on the beach and drank from one of the tide pools. Now she's feeling nauseous... among other things.
BI'd like to find out what she drank. Take this box, in it are some empty vials I labeled. Fill each at different pools and come back.
completion: Wonderful. You're back before she died. Good, good.
BLet's get started on this then, shall we?
BI've been studying her symptoms for some time now, and it's quite ugly. I'm surprised she's still standing. She's vomited three or four times all over the place... quite a pleasant odor.
BGive me just a moment to put something together to test on our... friend.

3640.name: The Pledge of Secrecy
desc: If you agree to become a Gnome Engineer, then right-click on the Pledge of Secrecy and speak once more with Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge.
objectives: If you agree to become a Gnome Engineer, then right-click on the Pledge of Secrecy and speak once more with Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge.
details: Gnome engineering is about engineering theory shaped to serve our needs! Our schemata allow us to make devices that control the world around us; the manual you read covered this.
BThe manual also covered our ages old oath of secrecy on our schemata. Once you become a gnome engineer, that's that. There is no access to goblin engineering at all.
BIf you still want to become a gnome engineer, sign this document pledging life-long secrecy and speak with me again. Think about it carefully, $N.
completion: Welcome aboard, $N! You soon will have access to the most advanced engineering schemata anywhere on Azeroth.

BNow that you have committed yourself to the pursuit of this knowledge, it is time to examine your gnome-oriented engineering work. From there, we'll help you build a plan to maximize your gnome engineering talents!

3784.name: Assisting Arch Druid Runetotem
desc: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
details: Excuse me $c, but I'd like just a moment of your time if possible.

BThe Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is most interested in seasoned adventurers such as yourself to lend them aid in a vital research project. While I do not know the specifics, I can inform you that none other than Hamuul Runetotem is spearheading this research.
BPlease - if you are interested, speak with him directly on the Elder Rise within Thunder Bluff proper.
completion: Greetings, $C; I am glad you are interested in assisting our research. There is much to do, and I would be doing you a disservice if I informed you that the work this entails is not dangerous. Hopefully this will not scare you off... but from the looks of you, I take it that danger is something that you have dealt with before.

3904.name: Milly's Harvest
desc: Bring 8 crates of Milly's Harvest to Milly Osworth at Northshire Abbey.
objectives: Bring 8 crates of Milly's Harvest to Milly Osworth at Northshire Abbey.
details: A gang of brigands, the Defias, moved into the Northshire Vineyards while I was harvesting! I reported it to the Northshire guards and they assured me they'd take care of things, but... I'm afraid for my crop of grapes! If the Defias don't steal them then I fear our guards will trample them when they chase away the thugs.
BPlease, you must help me! I gathered most of my grapes into buckets, but I left them in the vineyards to the southeast.
BBring me those buckets! Save my harvest!
completion: Oh thank you, $N! You saved my harvest! And I hope you showed a few of those Defias that they can't cause trouble around here.
BWe might be short on guards these days, but we're lucky to have heroes like you to protect us!

4024.name: A Taste of Flame
desc: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay Bael'Gar.
You only know that the giant resides inside Blackrock Depths. Remember to use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt on Bael'Gar's remains to capture the Fiery Essence.
Return the Encased Fiery Essence to Cyrus Therepentous.
objectives: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay Bael'Gar.
BYou only know that the giant resides inside Blackrock Depths. Remember to use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt on Bael'Gar's remains to capture the Fiery Essence.
BReturn the Encased Fiery Essence to Cyrus Therepentous.
B
details: I wish to taste the searing flames of the mountain of fire. To let the molten fires of Blackrock cascade across my being. That essence, that searing heat, it is what I crave.
BBael'Gar resides in the Depths of Blackrock: A being of pure flame, born of the fires of Ragnaros. Slay Bael'Gar and from his smoldering remains bring for me a piece of his inner fire.
BUse the molt on his remains to safely extract the inner flame.
BSucceed and be rewarded.
completion: <Cyrus snatches the fiery essence from your hands.>
BYES!
BTake your prize and be gone. Leave my sight at once!

4120.name: The Strength of Corruption
desc: Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas wants you to kill 12 Angerclaw Grizzlies and 12 Felpaw Ravagers in Felwood.
objectives: Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas wants you to kill 12 Angerclaw Grizzlies and 12 Felpaw Ravagers in Felwood.
details: Being a hunter, I strive to emulate the strengths I see in my opponents. It is possible to turn the battle in your favor by simply knowing your enemy well, $N.

BIn a place called Felwood, north of Ashenvale, the creatures have been tainted by a substance called fel. The bears and wolves have been driven mad by it, but I believe that they have also grown even stronger as well.
BGo, $N. Travel to Felwood and face these beasts. Learn for yourself if they are truly as strong as I believe.
completion: It sounds from your descriptions as if the creatures show a mindless ferocity...
BStay alert, $N. It would be in your best interest to learn more of the corruption. Always know your enemy.

4144.name: Bloodpetal Sprouts
completion: Here goes nothing, $N! This will get Larion's attention!

4264.name: A Crumpled Up Note
desc: You may have just stumbled on to something that Marshal Windsor would be interested in seeing. There may be hope, after all.
objectives: You may have just stumbled on to something that Marshal Windsor would be interested in seeing. There may be hope, after all.
details: The note has stains covering its surface. The text is barely legible, but you make out the following:
B...sweet irony...
B...the fall of the broken Alliance...
B...if it were not for General Angerforge's diligence, we may have never discovered the pattern to the encryption...
B...Argelmach is almost done with the decryption of Windsor's notes.
BOur lord will rise from the depths and crush any that remain...
B-Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.$B
completion: <Marshal Windsor takes the note and begins reading.>

4288.name: The Western Pylon
desc: Discover the location of the Western Crystal Pylon.
objectives: Discover the location of the Western Crystal Pylon.
details: My experiments so far have not yielded any positive results, $N. I can't help but hope that you can find a solution by searching for one of the pylons that I have heard exist.
BPerhaps if we combine certain colors at them... but I get ahead of myself. Let's find them first!
B$N, search the western area of the crater; a pylon is said to be somewhere in that area.
completion: There are many hidden areas of the crater along the sides. Try exploring the winding paths if you can't think of anywhere else to look, $N.

4504.name: Super Sticky
desc: Collect 12 samples of Super Sticky Tar for Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.
objectives: Collect 12 samples of Super Sticky Tar for Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.
details: I'm always looking for a quick way to earn a gold, $N. If you help me with my newest idea, I'll let you in on a little of the profit. How does that sound to you?
BI thought so!

BHead to the tar pits in northern Un'Goro Crater, and collect me some tar. Not just any tar, now, you'll need to get it from the beasts that live around the tar pits. Regular tar just simply isn't sticky enough.
BThe plant-like creatures contain chlorophyll in their skin, and mixed with the tar, it's super sticky!
completion: Yes, this tar is just the stuff...
BHey, wait a minute, my hands... I can't seem to get them apart...
BMaybe this wasn't such a good idea. Oh, but wait! Super sticky tar remover! That's where the real money is!

4768.name: The Darkstone Tablet
desc: Bring the Darkstone Tablet to Shadow Mage Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.
objectives: Bring the Darkstone Tablet to Shadow Mage Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.
details: The Darkstone Tablet holds the writings of the long-dead dwarf Urheld Darkstone. An alchemist of great skill, he was thought insane by his contemporaries and, hence, did not share his research.

BBut he did etch it onto tablets, and I believe one such tablet lies in Blackrock Spire, in a chamber once named the Hall of Fortune. I know not what it is now called, for few enter Blackrock and return.
BBut if you are willing to brave its dangers and return to me with the tablet, your reward will be great.
completion: Excellent. The formulae etched into this tablet will consume days of research, but I am confident such research will bear sweet fruit.
BThank you, $N. You have been invaluable to us.

4864.name: Enraged Wildkin
desc: Pick up Jaron's Supplies from the snow, then find the wildkin that stole the amulet Jaron spoke of.
Bring Jaron's Supplies and the Blue-feathered Amulet to Jaron Stoneshaper at the lodge in Winterspring.
objectives: Pick up Jaron's Supplies from the snow, then find the wildkin that stole the amulet Jaron spoke of.
BBring Jaron's Supplies and the Blue-feathered Amulet to Jaron Stoneshaper at the lodge in Winterspring.
details: After inspecting the contents of the box, you decide that Jaron could make use of the tools and other items inside. However, there is no sign of the amulet.
BIt appears that the wildkin inhabit the lands to the north and east of here, so you decide that the next step is to face the creatures and reclaim the amulet from them.
completion: Well, I expected to hear as much, lad. I figured that the crazed beasts destroyed all of my belongings...
BBut you did find my tools, and most importantly, the amulet! I wonder why the wildkin so fiercely defended this item... In any case, I'll think twice before heading their way again!

4984.name: The Wildlife Suffers Too
desc: Destroy 8 Diseased Wolves, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.
objectives: Destroy 8 Diseased Wolves, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.
B
details: While there was little I could do alone to thwart the Scourge, I nevertheless came to these lands to try and heal the damage done to nature. Animals suffer from the plague that continues to choke these lands, unable to find mercy and peace. I ask for you to continue what I could not finish here.
BThere is no salvation for the suffering animals but a sweet and merciful release. Seek out diseased wolves nearby and put them down. Please $N, end their misery - doing so will surely soothe mine.
completion: I... I sense that the souls of those wolves you have put down now have rest. They - and I - thank you for a merciful release.
BThe wolves are not alone in their suffering within this damnable place, $N. Please, I have need of you once more.

5056.name: Shy-Rotam
desc: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to defeat Shy-Rotam.
objectives: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to defeat Shy-Rotam.
details: In northern Winterspring, great cats assemble around a large landmark called Frostsaber Rock. The leader of these cats is known by the name Shy-Rotam. Defeating the matriarch of the frostsabers would grant you much respect in the eyes of your fellow $r.

BGo again to the harsh wilds, and once there, gather sacred meat from the frostsabers. Find the stone of Shy-Rotam, and place it there. Placing the meat of her kin before her will summon Shy-Rotam, in anger.
BBe ready for her fury, and defeat her.
completion: You have proven both your strength and your determination. Many more challenges await you, but I have already shown you as much as I am able.
BGood luck, $N.

5128.name: Words of the High Chief
desc: Take the Crudely-written Log to Kelek Skykeeper in southern Felwood.
objectives: Take the Crudely-written Log to Kelek Skykeeper in southern Felwood.
details: The Winterfall are no longer a threat to me, but if you still want to find out what was driving the furbolg to create and consume this strange firewater, I think you should seek out Kelek Skykeeper.
BHe is part of a group known as the Emerald Circle, druids that are committed to their work in Felwood, healing the land from the corruption.
BKelek has much experience with the furbolgs in Felwood, and may be able to tell you more about the log.
BThank you, again, $N.
completion: Yes, if you let me examine this for a while, I might be able to translate it for you.
B<Kelek flips through the pages.>
BWhen I am able to look over this fully, I will send word to you.
BThank you for sharing this with me, $N. Very little is known about the Winterfall furbolg.

5152.name: Auntie Marlene
desc: Speak with Marlene, south of the Ruins of Andorhal.
objectives: Speak with Marlene, south of the Ruins of Andorhal.
details: Oh, I'm so lonely! Where is my family? Auntie Marlene told me to stay here, but then she left and never came back! And my dad... have you seen him?
BMaybe Auntie Marlene knows where he is. She lives near Andorhal, in a house to the south. I think it was on a hill... she said it was on a hill.
BPlease, $N. You're my new friend! Will you talk to my Auntie for me?
completion: You saw Pamela? How is she? Is she alive?? Oh, no! Poor Pamela! She was so young, and such a happy child...
BShe doesn't know what happened to her father, does she? My brother, Joseph?
BNo... she couldn't understand what happened to Joseph. And even if she could, I don't have the heart to tell her...

5248.name: Tormented By the Past
desc: Take the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Lake Kel'Theril in Winterspring and find a highborne spirit that will speak to you.
objectives: Take the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Lake Kel'Theril in Winterspring and find a highborne spirit that will speak to you.
details: $N, I weep for what has happened in the past. Like this crystal, the elves, as a race, have been shattered. I do not know if the pieces will ever again be reunited into one, but my sorrow has been eased by being able to help you with this one small task.
BWe must not forget the past, $N...

BPlease take the Crystal of Zin-Malor back to Lake Kel'Theril. You must find a highborne spirit that realizes the error of what was done so long ago. Show the spirit that we have made things right again.
completion: Pleeease, leeeave meeeeee...

5344.name: The Last Barov
desc: Travel to the Bulwark - Horde territory - and assassinate Alexi Barov. Take his head and return to Weldon Barov.
Be warned, Alexi will probably be well protected by Horde filth.
objectives: Travel to the Bulwark - Horde territory - and assassinate Alexi Barov. Take his head and return to Weldon Barov.
BBe warned, Alexi will probably be well protected by Horde filth.
details: With the deeds recovered, there is but one thing left to do. Alexi must be killed. With him dead, I need not ever worry about an unscrupulous gang of mercenaries seeking my head.
BIt's a simple task. Alexi hides under the protection of the Horde - at the Bulwark.
BNo, I do not expect you to just walk up and kill him, I want his head! How you get it... well, that part is up to you. That type of behavior is below one of my noble upbringing.
completion: A glorious day it is! Finally, the pockmark of house Barov eliminated and my fortune secure!
BTake this and leave my sight, peasant.

5464.name: Menethil's Gift
desc: Take the Soulbound Keepsake to Leonid Barthalomew in Eastern Plaguelands.
objectives: Take the Soulbound Keepsake to Leonid Barthalomew in Eastern Plaguelands.
details: The soul of the fallen clings to that which represents its former life and transforms the item into a soulbound keepsake. You pick the item up and place it in your pack.
completion: As the soul clung to the keepsake, so shall it cling to the physical form of Ras Frostwhisper.

5536.name: A Land Filled with Hatred
desc: Kill 6 Haldarr Satyr, 2 Haldarr Tricksters, 2 Haldarr Felsworn and then return to Loh'atu on the border of Ashenvale.
objectives: Kill 6 Haldarr Satyr, 2 Haldarr Tricksters, 2 Haldarr Felsworn and then return to Loh'atu on the border of Ashenvale.
details: The satyr, a disfigured, evil aspect of the night elves, now infect the sacred lands once traveled by Cenarius. I cannot speak for the night elves when it comes to all the atrocities those demonic creatures have committed, but I have sworn an oath to the Earthmother to aid the elves in ridding the land of such a nuisance.
BI am sure you would prove yourself if you aided me in purging them.
