BNortheast of here, you can find the Haldarr clan. Return to me after you've tested yourself against their power.
completion: Well done, $C. I see you're not only skilled but cunning. To defeat such creatures is a testament to your loyalty to the tenants of the Earthmother, even if you do not recognize her as your own deity. She is in all things on this planet and beyond. Her eyes, one dark and one light, travel across the skies always gazing down upon us.
BPlease, take this small amount of coin in appreciation for what you have done.

5632.name: Returning Home
desc: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
objectives: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
details: Oh, yes, of course. Hello, $N. A messenger from our order was here not too long ago looking for you. She mentioned something important happening back in Darnassus and that you should return to the Temple of the Moon as soon as you can. When you arrive, speak to Priestess Alathea. I believe it has something to do with your progressing so well in our ways.
BAgain, return to Darnassus when you can.
completion: Wonderful, you've returned home, $N. It always pleases Tyrande and myself when those we've trained go out into the world and return to us safely. How have things been with you? Does Elune still bless your travels? Perhaps after we speak more about the business at hand, you could tell me more of your travels.

5656.name: Hex of Weakness
desc: Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.
details: It always warms my undying heart to see priests from all cultures wander the world. To know that power exists that is not arcane and well within our grasp. That's why it is my honor to direct you home, $N.
BUr'kyo, your great priest in Orgrimmar, has asked for your presence. You can find him in the Valley of Spirits.
completion: You would do well to pay heed to this lesson, young one. The Hex of Weakness will be a great boon to you in battle. Later I will have tests for you to further yourself and prove your worth to the tribe.

5680.name: Shadowguard
desc: Speak to Ur'kyo in Ogrimmar.
objectives: Speak to Ur'kyo in Ogrimmar.
details: Like many of our own priests, your own tribe puts you through rites of passage. These rites often teach priests special abilities that are vital to their survival. I sense that time is upon you even as we speak. You must return to the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar and speak to Ur'kyo. What he teaches you might be very important for the future.
completion: Your rites will come soon enough. For now, I teach you a spell that will be of great use to you when you do battle with your enemies.

5728.name: Hidden Enemies
desc: Kill Bazzalan and Jergosh the Invoker before returning to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Kill Bazzalan and Jergosh the Invoker before returning to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
details: Hmm, leaders of the Searing Blade... this concerns me most. If they are the ones of value to Neeru, then those are who we must target first. This satyr... Bazzalan, and the other Neeru mentioned--what was he, a warlock?--must be slain.

BReturn to the Cleft of Shadow and enter Ragefire Chasm, $N. Find these two leaders of the Searing Blade, and kill them. But be careful not to let Neeru know it was you who did this. You must retain your identity as one of his $gbrothers:sisters; in arms.
completion: I am glad you've returned, $N. Some of those loyal to me brought word immediately that the caverns below Orgrimmar were in disarray now that their leaders have been slain. I even heard reports that Neeru was more than agitated. It seems we've put a dent in his armor. I can't say I'm displeased... even with such a minor victory.

5848.name: Of Love and Family
desc: Travel to Stratholme, in the northern part of the Plaguelands. It is in the Scarlet Bastion that you will find the painting 'Of Love and Family,' hidden behind another painting depicting the twin moons of our world.
Return the painting to Tirion Fordring.
objectives: Travel to Stratholme, in the northern part of the Plaguelands. It is in the Scarlet Bastion that you will find the painting 'Of Love and Family,' hidden behind another painting depicting the twin moons of our world.
BReturn the painting to Tirion Fordring.
details: The painting... It hung on the wall of my workshop - inside the Order's barracks - for years.
BAfter Tirion's trial was over, I knew that I could no longer keep the painting visible. I hid it in a place that they would never think to look.

BTravel to Stratholme and make your way deep inside what is now the Scarlet Bastion, search for a painting of our twin moons. Chip away at the paint until you uncover my master work, 'Of Love and Family.'
BMay the Light guide your actions.
completion: <Tirion nearly collapses when he sees the painting.>
B<He begins to sob in an almost frenetic manner.>

5944.name: In Dreams
desc: Escort Taelan Fordring out of Hearthglen.
objectives: Escort Taelan Fordring out of Hearthglen.
details: For so long, I have been a puppet of the Grand Crusader. What reason was there to fight against what the Scarlet Crusade had become? It has been decades, yet the memories of my father; those precious memories, they are what have kept me alive.

BI have dreams, stranger. In these dreams my father is with me. He stands proudly at my side as I am inducted into the Order. We battle legion of Scourge, side by side. We bring honor to the Alliance, to Lordaeron.
BI want not to dream anymore.
BTake me to him.
completion: The death of my son at the hands of these monsters will not pass without incident. Take solace in knowing that the Order is reborn.
BI now take my place as Highlord of the new Order of the Silver Hand.
BThese possessions of my past - they are all that I have to offer for all that you have done. Please, take these as a symbol of my gratitude; all have served me well over the years.
BMay we meet again, in better times, and reminisce of days long past... battles hard fought... dreams redeemed.

6064.name: Taming the Beast
desc: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Large Crag Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.
objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Large Crag Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.
details: Hi there, $Glad:lass;! So, you'd be wanting to know how you can gain a pet of your own?

BWell, let's get started. There's nothing more important than yer equipment when it comes to hunting, but we can chat about my new Shrapnel Blaster some other time. Fer now, let's focus on something I'm sure you're quite interested in: a pet!
BThe best way to learn is for you to try out several creatures as companions and see what ya like. So, find a large crag boar, then use the taming rod to tame it.
completion: I know, I know; you're wondering what's next, aren't ya?!

6088.name: Taming the Beast
desc: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Swoop. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.
objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Swoop. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.
details: The final task that I have for you requires that you tame a creature that inhabits the sky. The swoop is a difficult opponent, but as your ally, you will acquire its sharp attacks and threatening presence.

BBy the will of the Earthmother, when you return I will bestow you with the skills you will need to tame an animal of your choosing to be your companion; this creature will face the challenges you face, and gain experience alongside you. I will also show you how to call it and dismiss it as you wish.$B
completion: You have learned all I can teach you, $N. May the blessings of the Earthmother guide you in choosing a pet.
BHere you are, $N. I will now give you the power to tame a beast, as well as call it and dismiss it as you see fit. Use your new skills with pride and honor the Earthmother.

6136.name: The Corpulent One
desc: Find Borelgore in the northern wastes of Eastern Plaguelands and destroy him. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when the mission is complete.
objectives: Find Borelgore in the northern wastes of Eastern Plaguelands and destroy him. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when the mission is complete.
details: Past the Argent Dawn encampment of Light's Hope and west of Northdale, you will find the corpulent maggot beast, Borelgore.
BI've lost entire regiments to that monster. His size knows no bounds! The more he eats the greater his girth becomes...
BWhile I would not suffer any emotional harm should the beast devour you, I would prefer that you were the victor. Borelgore has been known to devour others who tried to hunt him.
completion: Keep this up and I may have to promote you from imbecile to mental deficient, first class.

6184.name: Flint Shadowmore
desc: Travel to Chillwind Camp in the Western Plaguelands and meet up with your contact, Flint Shadowmore.
objectives: Travel to Chillwind Camp in the Western Plaguelands and meet up with your contact, Flint Shadowmore.$B
details: The only information we have thus far, then, is that Nathanos Marris may have been slain by this Blightcaller. We assume the Blightcaller is the same fiend that disposed of my agents.

BFlint Shadowmore, another SI:7 operative, is stationed at the Alliance encampment of Chillwind Point in the Western Plaguelands. Seek him out; he will debrief you on the current situation in the Plagues and give you an assignment.
BGood luck, $N.
completion: The first mission will be straight up, $N. You go in, you come out. Recon...

6544.name: Torek's Assault
desc: Escort Torek on his attack against Silverwing Outpost and Duriel Moonfire, then report to Ertog Ragetusk at Splintertree Post.
objectives: Escort Torek on his attack against Silverwing Outpost and Duriel Moonfire, then report to Ertog Ragetusk at Splintertree Post.
details: Hey! $C! Come here!

BMy raiders and I are about to attack the Silverwing Outpost to the west. Our target is its leader, Duriel Moonfire. Scouts report the outpost is defended heavily with sentinels and warriors. The battle will be glorious!
BDo you want to share in the glory, $N, and aid us? If so, then when it's over you can report our success to my superior, Ertog Ragetusk in Splintertree.
BWhat do you say. Are you with us?
completion: So Torek's attack was successful! Well done, $N. Night elves are decent foes. A little skinny, but strong and fierce! I'm sure the battle was something to see...
BAnd I hope you gained a scar or two!

6568.name: The Testament of Rexxar
desc: Deliver Rexxar's Letter to Myranda the Hag in the Western Plaguelands.
objectives: Deliver Rexxar's Letter to Myranda the Hag in the Western Plaguelands.
details: Illusion and disguise. That is how you will fool the Black Dragonflight, and gain what you seek.
BThough I could teach you something of the skills of deception, you need the help of a master.

BI know of one who could do this. In the Western Plaguelands, you will find Myranda the Hag, once a master illusionist of Lordaeron. She has helped us in the past, and if she believes the cause worthy, she may help you.
BTake this message to her.
completion: <Myranda holds the note, pauses, then smiles.>

BHow is he? Rexxar, I mean. Oh, come now, do not look so confused. The letter was left intentionally blank. It carried with it the intentions and thoughts of its creator. Judging from its contents, it is no wonder Rexxar left it as such. Imagine if you were captured or slain and this information discovered!
BOh, nevermind! Myranda will help you, $R. I owe the Warchief a favor or two.
B<Myranda smiles.>

7024.name: Great-father Winter is Here!
desc: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.
details: Have a wondrous Winter Veil, friend! Be sure to say hello to Greatfather Winter, who's currently in Orgrimmar! If you've been nice this year, you'll receive wondrous treats on the day of the Feast of Winter Veil. Be sure to tell him what you hope to get this year!

BAlso, be sure to stock up on treats to give those who've been nice this year. We have a great selection to choose from. Fresh from our farm to your plate - it's Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness!
completion: Ho ho hello. I am Greatfather Winter, and I - courtesy of the fine folks of Smokywood Pastures... "Fresh from our farm to your plate, it's Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness" - would like to wish you a fantastic Feast of Winter Veil.
BIf you've been good this year, maybe you will receive treats from Smokywood Pastures as your treat for the Feast of Winter Veil. Huzzah.

7168.name: Rise and Be Recognized
details: Most do not live long enough to rise above their own mediocrity. You have proven yourself to be an exemplary soldier, $C. The time has come.
BPresent your insignia.
completion: Let our enemies see that a soldier of rank has struck them down! Fight for the glory of Stormpike!

7504.name: Holy Bologna: What the Light Won't Tell You
desc: Return the book to its rightful owners.
objectives: Return the book to its rightful owners.
details: The tome carries the mark of the Athenaeum.
completion: Excellent work, $R. Should you find any more tomes, do not hesitate to return them to us.
BAs time passes, we tend to change around and even add new rewards for the return of missing tomes.

items.name: Holy Bologna: What the Light Won't Tell You

7624.name: Ulathek the Traitor
desc: Confront Ulathek, then bring The Traitor's Heart to Lord Banehollow in Jaedenar.
objectives: Confront Ulathek, then bring The Traitor's Heart to Lord Banehollow in Jaedenar.
details: You wish to enter my good graces? Then kill for me.
BMy servant, Ulathek, is pathetic how he grovels before me, all the while plotting with Lord Hel'nurath on Xoroth. Hel'nurath plans to usurp my power here, and Ulathek is his spy...

BProve that you serve me and not my rivals. Confront Ulathek in his quarters, in the Shadow Hold to the west. Tell him that I know his secret and watch as fear grips him. Then, bring me the traitor's heart!
completion: Ah, how splendid! After rotting a week, this heart will prove a succulent treat! Perhaps I will send for Ulathek's head and place it before me as I eat...
BYou have done me a service, warlock, and so my patience for you has grown. Marginally.

7648.name: Grimand's Finest Work
desc: Take the Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District for his inspection.
objectives: Take the Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District for his inspection.
details: <Grimand wipes sweat from his brow, beaming with a sense of pride.>

BThere you are, my friend. This is some of my finest work - as good as the barding I personally made for Lord Shadowbreaker when he went for his own charger. I thank you for your trust in me to provide for you the best.
BNo doubt Grayson will want to see the work for himself as well. Take your barding to him, and give him my thanks for his honorable business.
completion: This is most impressive work. It seems that as Grimand gets older, his craftsmanship continues to improve. That's quite the feat when his work was already some of the finest you'd find anywhere when he made my barding back in the day.

BWhile this barding would be a fine addition to any normal steed, we are not dealing with such a mundane beast. You'll need this barding blessed by an appropriate source for it to be worthy of resting on a $C's charger. I'll hold onto it for you until then.

7792.name: A Donation of Wool
completion: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, $N!

7816.name: Gammerita, Mon!
desc: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill Gammerita and retrieve Katoom's Best Lure from her corpse.
Katoom mentioned that Gammerita hangs out on the coast with the other turtles.
objectives: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill Gammerita and retrieve Katoom's Best Lure from her corpse.
BKatoom mentioned that Gammerita hangs out on the coast with the other turtles.
details: Yo! There be a turtle out there not like the others. She be the Gammerita, leader of the saltwater snapjaws - a downright dirty thievin' reptile.
BMon, she stole my best lure. Snapped it right off my line! Since then, the fish just aren't biting the same.
BFind Gammerita and get my lure out of her stomach.
completion: MON! This is fantastic! With my best lure and the snapjaw population down, the fish will pile up.

7840.name: Lard Lost His Lunch
desc: Lard at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Lard's Lunch. Return to him when this task is complete.
Lard mentioned that he left it on the island to the north. Watch out for Vilebranch trolls.
objectives: Lard at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Lard's Lunch. Return to him when this task is complete.
BLard mentioned that he left it on the island to the north. Watch out for Vilebranch trolls.
details: Lard was at secret special spot having picnic when ugly mean Vilebranch hit Lard wit da big stick. Lard run back to Revantusk but forget Lard lunch. Lard hungry. Maybe you go back to secret special spot and get Lard lunch? Lard scared. Go nort! Island der to da nort is da secret special spot.
completion: <Lard takes the huge haunch of meat from you and stuffs it in his face.>
BDis hit da spot! Tanks little one.
BLard make you special picnic basket for help Lard.

7864.name: Sentinel Standard Care Package
completion: You've certainly begun to prove yourself to us, $N. As a reward, please take this care package! Inside it you'll find rations and bandages that are usable only inside Warsong Gulch.

BAs you continue to prove yourself inside the Gulch, you'll find that these items will become available to you for purchase. Rations become available when you are Friendly with us, and bandages when you are Honored.

7888.name: Talismans of Merit
desc: You obtained a Silverwing Talisman of Merit for your last task, talk to me again, and you gain your reward.

8056.name: Paragons of Power: The Augur's Bracers
desc: Bring Maywiki of Zuldazar a Primal Hakkari Armsplint. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
Maywiki of Zuldazar is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
objectives: Bring Maywiki of Zuldazar a Primal Hakkari Armsplint. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
BMaywiki of Zuldazar is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
details: The augurs of our tribe are revered for their gifts of the divine sight, ya mon. They ain't a witch doctor; they spend their time castin' bones or readin' the leaves for insight - not hexin' people. As a shaman, you already know somethin' about the power of augury; we Zandalar prize the insight they give to the tribe.
BBring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub and prove your worth to us. Do this for us, and I'll give ya some bracers that our augurs prize above all others!
completion: It seems ya got a bit of the Zandalar augur in ya. We know about the deeds you've been doin' in Zul'Gurub on our behalf mon. These Paragons of Power will go a long way to helpin' out the Zandalar tribe - a tribe, I might add, ya can call upon as friends. Take these bracers, $N; ya earned them and then some!

8080.name: Arathi Basin Resources!
desc: Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Sergeant Maclear at Refuge Pointe.
objectives: Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Sergeant Maclear at Refuge Pointe.
details: War must be fought with soldiers, any soldier will tell you. They'll also say that a battle fought with poor gear or on an empty stomach is lost before it starts!
BThat is why Arathi Basin is important. There are key areas in the basin that hold essential resources. Metals, weapons, food, lumber - all are needed, and all can be gained there.
BThat is what I want from you, $N. Enter Arathi Basin, win the battle by holding more bases than the enemy, and return to me with a crate of resources.
completion: You got the resources! Great job! I'll send the resources to our quartermasters, who can quickly disperse them to our troops.
BThank you, $N. Indeed, performing successful missions like the one you achieved are how wars are truly won.

8104.name: The Jewel of Kajaro
completion: <Al'tabim shatters the pebble with a powerful unseen force.>

BDo you see? The pebble is what we call a geode. Inside the pebble are powerful crystals that have been soaking in the latent energies from our world. By cutting the pebble in half, I have finally allowed its full potential to be realized. Use it to lay waste to our enemies.

8272.name: Hero of the Frostwolf
completion: NULL

8320.name: Twilight Geolords
desc: Kill 10 Twilight Geolords, then return to Huum Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
objectives: Kill 10 Twilight Geolords, then return to Huum Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
details: The Twilight's Hammer, an insane cult bent on destruction, set up camps in Silithus and perform rituals day and night. We do not yet know their plans, but we do think they are somehow linked to the pulsing red crystals spread across the desert.

BAlthough their mystery may one day be solved, we must first deal with their immediate threat. Go to their camps to the west and seek out Twilight geolords. They are the heads of these serpents; that is where we must strike!
completion: That was a task well performed, $N. Your slaying of the Twilight geolords must have dealt a grievous blow to the cult. Let us hope their plans are slowed...

8368.name: Battle of Warsong Gulch
desc: Bring 3 Warsong Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
objectives: Bring 3 Warsong Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
details: The battle in Warsong Gulch against the Silverwing Sentinels is of great importance. Under the guise of protecting a forest that doesn't belong to them, the Alliance seeks to deny the Horde one of our largest sources for lumber.
BDo not let this happen, $N! Come back to me with proof of serving the Horde in a worthy manner!
completion: Excellent! You've shown your worth by defending our operations in Warsong Gulch! May word of your honor spread far and wide across our lands.

8392.name: Claiming Arathi Basin
desc: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.

8416.name: Inert Scourgestones
desc: Bring the Inert Scourgestone to Commander Ashlan Valorfist in Chillwind Point.
objectives: Bring the Inert Scourgestone to Commander Ashlan Valorfist in Chillwind Point.
details: The evil has been purged from the stones, $n.
BI am aware of Commander Ashlam's plans, and he will require only a single inert stone. Bring it to him so we may bathe the Scourge in righteous fire.
completion: You have done as I asked without question, $N.
BTrust is achieved, it seems. Perhaps I can reveal our plan in more detail to you now.

8440.name: Conquering Arathi Basin
desc: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

8464.name: Winterfall Activity
desc: Salfa wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Shaman, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Ursa. Salfa is located just outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold in Winterspring.
objectives: Salfa wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Shaman, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Ursa. Salfa is located just outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold in Winterspring.
details: The Timbermaw tend to stay to themselves, $N. While we do allow safe passage to those we trust, we try to avoid other furbolg tribes if at all possible.
BThe Winterfall tribe as of late has become increasingly hostile towards us. They seem to be in a state of rage, completely engulfed by their own fear and hatred of anything they do not understand.
BI must ask you to thin their numbers as to lessen the threat against us. Seek them out in Winterfall Village, far to the east of here.
completion: Thank you for what you have done, as saddening as it is. Accept this as a token of thanks.

BI would ask of you to please continue helping us, $N. We have very few allies on which to call upon, and without your aid, the threats against my tribe would surely be too much for us to handle alone.

8512.name: The Alliance Needs Light Leather!
desc: Bring 10 light leather to Bonnie Stoneflayer at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8536.name: Earthen Templar
desc: Summon and slay an Earthen Templar and report back to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing III in order to complete this quest.

8560.name: Conqueror's Legguards
desc: Bring Ouro's Intact Hide, 2 Idols of Death, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Kandrostrasz inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

8584.name: Never Ask Me About My Business
desc: Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris wants you to speak with Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan.
objectives: Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris wants you to speak with Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan.
details: If there is one thing that you should know about me, it is this: NEVER ask me about my business! I work with things you simply cannot understand. Like for example: Do you know what a psychotronic muzzledorf is? Of course you don't! And that's why we leave the planning to me and the fetching to you.
BAs I said earlier, if this is going to work, we're going to need a 500 pound chicken.
BHead to Gadgetzan and speak with Dirge Quikcleave - he'll get you started on finding a suitable specimen.$B
completion: <Dirge scratches his head.>
BA 500 pound chicken? There's no such thing! Not anymore, at least. I knew of such a chicken... The Black Chicken of Death...
B<Dirge's voice trails off.>
BBut yes, nobody ever saw that chicken and lived to tell the tale. I've got an idea that could benefit the both of us, kid.

8608.name: The Horde Needs More Mageweave Bandages!
desc: Bring 20 Mageweave Bandages to Lady Callow at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.

8632.name: Enigma Circlet
desc: Bring Vek'nilash's Circlet, 2 Idols of Night, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

8656.name: Striker's Hauberk
desc: Bring the the Carapace of the Old God, 2 Idols of Life, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

8680.name: Windtotem the Elder
completion: Your spirit burns with life, young $C. I accept the homage you pay, and offer in return this token...

8704.name: Signet of the Unseen Path
desc: Bring 1 Qiraji Ceremonial Ring, 2 Amber Idols, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Ceremonial Ring, 2 Amber Idols, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
details: The rings worn by the Qiraji lieutenants are rumored to grant them formidable abilities. The corrupted gems that adorn them could, in theory, be swapped out with more pure materials to create uncorrupted versions of the rings.
BThe gems that adorn Qiraji idols would work quite well, as their quality is superior.
BBring me the ring and idols and I'll create a powerful ring for you, $c.
completion: I will swap the gem on the ring for you. You'll find the effect is much more... agreeable.

8728.name: The Good News and The Bad News
desc: Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris wants you to bring him 20 Arcanite Bars, 10 Elementium Ore, 10 Azerothian Diamonds, and 10 Blue Sapphires.
objectives: Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris wants you to bring him 20 Arcanite Bars, 10 Elementium Ore, 10 Azerothian Diamonds, and 10 Blue Sapphires.
details: Well that took a little longer than expected. Now let me see what this ledger says.
B<Narain silently reads the ledger, periodically mumbling under his breath.>
B The good news is that I am 99% certain that I am capable of creating an arcanite buoy that will function to your specifications. This is, of course, wholly dependant on the bad news.
BThe bad news is that I'm going to need a lot of arcanite, elementium ore, and rare gemstones.
BBring me what I need and I will craft the buoy.
completion: A deal is a deal. I sure hope you know what you are getting yourself into, $N. This is an awful lot of trouble to go through to do some fishing.

8752.name: The Path of the Conqueror
completion: Impressive, little one. You have gone through much trouble to gain the favor of the Bronze Flight. Your dedication is noted.$b$bThe signet ring of the conqueror will greatly enhance your physical attacks.$b$bBe warned, once you have chosen your path, you will have no recourse should you change your mind.

8776.name: Target: Hive'Regal Slavemakers
desc: Kill 30 Hive'Regal Slavemakers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing X in order to complete this quest.

8800.name: Cenarion Battlegear
desc: Talk to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
objectives: Talk to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
details: As you complete the tasks you're assigned in the war you'll want to talk to Vargus, the blacksmith. Show him any badges you've earned along the way. He'll provide you with gear to match your level of commitment to our cause.
completion: Kaldon sent you? Very well, let's see what we can do for you.

8872.name: The Lunar Festival
desc: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger at the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.
objectives: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger at the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.
details: It's that time of the year, $N! The Cenarion Circle invites all denizens of Azeroth to partake in our celebration of the Lunar Festival. You will find the Lunar Festival Harbinger in this very city at a location marked by a blessed circle of moonlight. She can tell you more about the holiday.
completion: Welcome, $N. Are you here to join in the festivities?

8920.name: An Earnest Proposition
desc: Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Bracers of Valor to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Bracers of Valor to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.$B
details: Hail, $c! I can tell by your demeanor that you've seen and done much in this world. Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this.
BPerform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers.
BI'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus. Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.
completion: Ah, yes. Mux will be quite happy with this.
BThose bracers were part of a larger armor set. If you're interested in providing me with further assistance, I'd be willing to consider parting with the rest of it.

8944.name: Just Compensation
desc: Bring a Belt of Valor and a set of Gauntlets of Valor to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring a Belt of Valor and a set of Gauntlets of Valor to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.$B
details: You've proven to be a very reliable individual, $N. As much as I trust that you'll help me through this predicament, it would be wise of me to reward you according to your performance.
BFor now I will exchange your belt and gauntlets. If we both see this through I shall make the rest of the pieces available to you.
completion: Our agreement remains in place. Just remember, this is but a taste of what awaits you. Free me of this cursed fate and I will reward you with items of truly great power.

8968.name: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
desc: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth Jarien and Sothos and slay them. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
objectives: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth Jarien and Sothos and slay them. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
details: The siblings, Jarien and Sothos, decided to join the Scarlet Crusade upon the disbanding of our mercenary company. They took the left piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet with them. Good riddance, I say, but we need that piece back.
BFrom what we could gather, they were actually slain by Grand Crusader Dathrohan himself for failing the initiation rites inside his chamber in the Scarlet Bastion.
BIn any case, we... meaning you, are still going to need to retrieve that piece of the amulet.
completion: I suppose it's for the best that the souls of those two have finally been put to rest, even if I didn't like them while they were alive. In any case, we have what we were after, and that is definitely a good thing!

BUnfortunately, I do not know the location of the one who died with the right piece of the amulet in their possession. But do not fear; in life I was a dabbler in the art of divination, so I have another task for you, which is going to enable us to ferret out the final piece.

8992.name: The Right Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
desc: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Kormok and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
objectives: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Kormok and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
details: Now we have what we need, so it's time to discuss who it is that you'll be summoning next.

BKormok was ok for an ogre, right up until he turned to necromancy. After that, things got creepy for just about everyone in the outfit. It was no surprise then when he took his piece of the amulet and returned to his new home, Scholomance.
BBut even there, or perhaps especially there, he was not safe from the spectral assassins. They slew him right in front of his master, Ras Frostwhisper.
completion: Good work, $N! Kormok wasn't all that bad for an ogre, at least not while he was still alive, so I hope he gets the rest that he deserves. And now we have the completed amulet! But we still have the hardest test ahead of us.
BIn order for the brazier to be attuned to calling forth Lord Valthalak, there are a few more items that need to be gathered and brought back to me here.

9016.name: Anthion's Parting Words
desc: Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Wildheart Boots, a Wildheart Kilt and Wildheart Spaulders.
objectives: Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Wildheart Boots, a Wildheart Kilt and Wildheart Spaulders.$B
details: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.

BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together. Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for.
BI, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
completion: This curse was bestowed upon us but for a mere medallion. Lord Valthalak certainly knows how to hold a grudge.
BWe'll endeavor to find the remaining pieces - hopefully before I meet an untimely demise. But before that, let us see about your reward.

9040.name: Dreadnaught Gauntlets
desc: Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Dreadnaught Gauntlets if you bring him the following items: 1 Desecrated Gauntlets, 8 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 5 Cured Rugged Hides.

9088.name: Dreamwalker Headpiece
desc: Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Dreamwalker Headpiece if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Headpiece, 15 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 6 Cured Rugged Hides and 2 Nexus Crystals.

9112.name: Leggings of Faith
desc: Father Inigo Montoy at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Leggings of Faith if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Leggings, 20 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 4 Mooncloth and 2 Nexus Crystals.

9136.name: Savage Flora
desc: Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Savage Fronds.
objectives: Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Savage Fronds.
details: I make a special type of armor for the brave heroes that enter Naxxramas known as Dreamwalker. They are able to provide me with most of the materials I require but I am always looking for those able to retrieve savage fronds from the flora of our world.
BYou may think of this job as beneath you, but without the fronds, the armor could not be made.
BI am also in a unique position to pay you with an insignia of your choice as both the Dawn and the Crusade supply me with funds.$B
completion: I am much obliged, $N.
B<Rayne bows.>
BPlease remember that I am always acceptINg fronds.

9184.name: Craftsman's Writ - Wicked Leather Headband
desc: Deliver 10 Wicked Leather Headbands and the Craftsman's Writ - Wicked Leather Headband - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

9208.name: The Savage Guard - Arcanum of Protection
desc: Zanza the Restless in Zul'Gurub wants an Arcanum of Protection.

9232.name: The Only Song I Know...
desc: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants you to bring him 2 Frozen Runes, 2 Essence of Water, 2 Blue Sapphires and 30 gold pieces.
objectives: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants you to bring him 2 Frozen Runes, 2 Essence of Water, 2 Blue Sapphires and 30 gold pieces.
details: You fancy yourself a hero of the Dawn, eh? I've seen our greatest soldiers get rolled over by Kel'Thuzad's plebes! How well could someone so clueless possibly fare in Naxxramas?
B<Wilhelm sighs.>
BBah, what choice do I got? You're the best I can do; I may as well help you.
BOmarion left me with one recipe. It's the only song I know... I can make a few variations of these pants; you just gotta supply the materials.
completion: <Wilhelm wipes the sweat from his brow.>
BThat's some hard work! Enjoy the pants, $C. At least you'll die in a clean pair now.

9304.name: Document from the Front
desc: Take the Smudged Document to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
objectives: Take the Smudged Document to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
details: You found this letter on one of the many Scourge minions you've slain. From its appearance and smell, it has been with the undead for some time. Perhaps someone at Light's Hope Chapel would be interested in examining it further...
completion: How tragic. These words, clearly meant for someone the soldier loved, never made it to their destination. The events detailed happened years ago; I'm not sure if the intended recipient still lives.
BThere is hope yet, however. With the names and information he gives, I might be able to locate the family! It will take some research, but the librarian in Stormwind owes me a favor...
BThank you for bringing this to me. With your help, we may be able to grant someone peace of mind at least.

9664.name: Establishing New Outposts
desc: Capture Crown Guard Tower, Eastwall Tower, Northpass Tower and Plaguewood Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands, then return to Emmisary Whitebeard at Light's Hope Chapel.
objectives: Capture Crown Guard Tower, Eastwall Tower, Northpass Tower and Plaguewood Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands, then return to Emmisary Whitebeard at Light's Hope Chapel.
details: Welcome to the Plaguelands, $n. As you know, the Forsaken and their allies hold the lands to the west of here against our best efforts. The Alliance commanders have decided that here in the east, we will establish new fortifications to tighten the noose around our enemies.
BTowers long abandoned since the days of Lordaeron are to be seized and rebuilt for this purpose. These lands are dangerous, and we could use your help.
completion: Very good, $N. It will be important for us to hold these towers against future attacks, and for that we may need your assistance until reinforcements can be brought in to secure the area.

objectives: Speak to the Yala Windwatcher in Thendal Grove.
details: Ever since our elemental benefactors left us, it seems that we are simply moving from one unrest to another. The problem we face now is that the manifestations of the winds near the standing stones to the northeast are agitated.
Not truly self-aware like the sentient wind spirits that once lived here, these simple sprites respond in kind to forces, emotions, and intentions of the creatures around them.
My apprentice Yala Windwatcher went to observe them. Seek her out and discover what she's learned.

objectives: Bring the Titan Relic to High Explorer Magellas in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers.
*Titan Relic (Forever) (provided)
details: With titan-like inscriptions like that on its facets, nothing less than Ironforge's Hall of Explorers is the right place to bring it.
I'd like to think that you'll be noted in the history for it in the catalogue -- "Recovered by ! Authenticated by Prospector Whelgar..." Ah, I'm gettin' meself carried away.
High Explorer Magellas will receive you, and given the exquisite nature of what you carry, will surely be most generously appreciative should you donate it to the museum.
Good find!
